# Support

Use [GitHub issues](https://github.com/prufyx/prufyx/issues) for reproducible
bugs, supported-scope questions, and proposed public rules. Include the CLI
version, a minimal synthetic reproduction, expected result, and actual result.

Use [hello@prufyx.com](mailto:hello@prufyx.com) for private questions, and follow
[SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md) for vulnerabilities. Do not post credentials, raw
cluster observations, production manifests, or sensitive logs publicly.

Spas Atanasov maintains this early Community release. Support is best effort;
there are no production availability, compatibility, or response-time guarantees.
